label: Root links from Thomas Uebel, Vienna Circle
summary: §3.1, "useless to continue to search for an adequate criterion of testability in terms of deductive relationships to observation sentences": The report identifies Hempel's abandonment of a purely deductive observation-sentence test following the difficulties of overexclusion and trivial verification. It qualifies retaining that implementation of the case criterion. It gives no reason by itself to discard every non-deductive notion of empirical relevance.
